glossary.indicator: An indicator shows whether a result is being achieved. It names what is measured; it never contains the target.
glossary.baseline: The baseline is the indicator value before the intervention starts, with the date and method of measurement.
glossary.target: The target is the value the project intends to reach by a stated date. Intermediate (annual or midterm) targets are allowed.
glossary.meansOfVerification: The means of verification is the specific source and tool used to measure the indicator, for example “household survey, FCS module, n≈400, representative of target households”. Generic answers such as “project reports” are not acceptable.
glossary.disaggregation: Disaggregation breaks the indicator value down by groups: sex, age, disability, location, displacement status and others.
